description: Test prompts that verify rdk-cross-compilation triggers and produces correct cross-compile guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK developer would phrase them (Chinese). Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions.

evals.name: compile-on-board-too-slow
evals.prompt: 我在板子上直接 make 我的 C++ 项目，编译太慢了，能不能优化一下？
evals.expected_output: Interrupts the optimization framing, explains the board is an aarch64 SBC not suited for compilation, and routes to cross-compiling on an x86 host with the aarch64 toolchain.

assertions.text: Does NOT suggest make -j or other on-board compilation optimizations as the primary fix.
Explains the board is an aarch64 SBC and compiling on it is slow/resource-limited.
Routes to cross-compiling on an x86 host using gcc-arm-11.2 and aarch64_toolchainfile.cmake.
Mentions deploying the compiled binary to the board via scp.

evals.name: s600-tros-distro
evals.prompt: S600 的 TROS 该怎么交叉编译？用哪个 build 脚本？
evals.expected_output: S600 uses Jazzy (not Humble), shares s100_build.sh, and needs a Jazzy sysroot Docker.

assertions.text: States S600 uses Jazzy distro (/opt/tros/jazzy), NOT Humble.
States the build script is s100_build.sh (S600 shares the S100 build config).
Mentions the sysroot Docker needs Jazzy TROS headers, not Humble.

evals.name: cross-compile-vs-bpu-conversion
evals.prompt: 交叉编译和 hb_mapper 有什么区别？我两个都要做吗？
evals.expected_output: Explains cross-compilation produces native aarch64 binaries (CPU), while hb_mapper/hb_compile produces BPU model artifacts (.bin/.hbm). A project can need both.

assertions.text: Explains hb_mapper/hb_compile converts neural network models for the BPU (produces .bin/.hbm).
Explains cross-compilation compiles native C/C++/ROS2 code into aarch64 Linux binaries (runs on CPU).
Mentions a project can need both: cross-compile the C++ inference app + convert the model with hb_mapper.
Routes BPU model conversion to rdk-device skill.

evals.name: ros2-package-missing-headers
evals.prompt: 交叉编译一个依赖 rclcpp 的 ROS2 包，一直报 fatal error: ros2/rclcpp.hpp: No such file，怎么解决？
evals.expected_output: The bare toolchain lacks TROS headers. Need to set up the sysroot Docker with TROS headers + board libs.

assertions.text: Explains the bare cross-compiler (gcc-arm-11.2) cannot resolve TROS/ROS2 headers.
Routes to setting up the sysroot Docker (sysroot_docker repo).
Mentions the sysroot Docker provides /opt/tros headers + board system libs.

evals.name: cmake-toolchain-file
evals.prompt: CMake 交叉编译怎么配置？aarch64_toolchainfile.cmake 在哪获取？
evals.expected_output: Clone robot_dev_config repo, pass -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE to cmake, verify output with file command.

assertions.text: States the toolchain file is in the robot_dev_config repo (git clone -b develop).
Mentions passing -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=<path>/aarch64_toolchainfile.cmake to cmake.
Mentions verifying the output with 'file <binary>' showing ARM aarch64.
Notes the toolchain file is shared across all boards (not board-specific).

evals.name: board-build-script-lookup
evals.prompt: X5 的 TROS 交叉编译用哪个 build 脚本？X3 呢？
evals.expected_output: X5 uses x5_build.sh, X3 uses all_build.sh. References the cross_compile_lookup.py script or the cheat-sheet table.

assertions.text: States X5 uses x5_build.sh.
States X3 uses all_build.sh.
Mentions or references scripts/cross_compile_lookup.py for deterministic lookup.
